title: ADR 0008 rewrite: native in-process Python indexer (DEC-303 a1)
description: Rewrite ADR 0008 for the native tree-sitter design after DEC-303 (a1) superseded the pyright language-server route; the LSP measurement stays committed as the baseline and harness. Docs only, no build slice.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ADR 0008 names DEC-303 (a1), states the native design and the gate, and cites only committed files for every number
The held-out repository is a proposal with a measured annotation count and no second-repo ground truth is committed

implementationNotes: Draft committed locally on docs/GCLI-68-adr-0008-native-python (unpushed, CI hold). ADR 0008 rewritten for DEC-303 (a1); former ADR moved unchanged-but-status to test/python-lsp-measurement/lsp-design-record.md. Click annotation counts are in results/annotation-count.txt (7.1.2: 0/474 annotated; requests pin: 265/268). No second-repo ground truth committed; the repository is a proposal for opum-doc. AC1 and AC2 await review rounds.
